_comment: Raspberry Pi Imager custom OS list for Ragnar OS.
Host this JSON somewhere public and load it in Imager via
Ctrl+Shift+X -> set the custom repository URL, or append it to a list.
Per release, fill in the four values marked REPLACE_ME from the built
image: the download URL, the compressed (.img.xz) size + sha256, and the
uncompressed (.img) size + sha256. The build workflow emits the sha256 of
the .img.xz; `xz -l image.img.xz` prints the uncompressed size.
Alternatively, skip this file entirely and use Imager's 'Use custom' to

os_list.name: Ragnar OS (64-bit)
os_list.description: Network security & pentesting toolkit on Raspberry Pi OS Lite. Headless web UI on :8000; join Wi-Fi 'Ragnar' to onboard.
